meta.formula: Two-segment: demand_y = base × (1+g1)^(min(y,2037)−2025) × (1+g2)^max(0, y−2037). g1 = implied CAGR NEP 2024→2037; g2 = implied CAGR NEP 2037→2045 (scenario-specific).
meta.source: Segment 1 rates locked from NEP draft Kap.2 Abb.6 Brutto 2024→2037 (existing). Segment 2 from BNetzA Genehmigung Szenariorahmen 2025-2037/2045 Tabelle 14 Bruttostromverbrauch (per-scenario, not a range).
meta.superseded_single_cagr: Constant g1 through 2045 overstated long-run demand (Scenario B hit ~1360 TWh vs NEP B Brutto 1182).
meta.nep_note_999_twh: User-cited '~999 TWh' is not a clean Scenario-B 2037 Brutto figure in the approved Szenariorahmen (B Netto 2037=956.7, B Brutto 2037=1027.4; draft Abb.6 B Brutto was 1041.3). Segment-1 rate kept at locked +5.45%/yr as requested.
